# Test pe fmt command - prompt formatting standardization

# Format single file and write back
exec pe fmt -w prompt.txt
stdout 'formatted'

# Format with check - well formatted should pass
exec pe fmt --check well-formatted.txt

# Format check with issues should fail
! exec pe fmt --check badly-formatted.txt
stderr 'needs formatting'

# Format with anthropic style
exec pe fmt --style anthropic anthropic-prompt.txt
stdout 'Human:'

# Test auto-fix
exec pe fmt --fix -w prompt-with-issues.txt
stdout 'formatted'

# Format multiple files
exec pe fmt -w prompt.txt well-formatted.txt
stdout 'prompt.txt: formatted'
stdout 'well-formatted.txt: formatted'

-- prompt.txt --
Tell me about AI.

-- well-formatted.txt --
Please explain the concept of artificial intelligence in simple terms.

-- badly-formatted.txt --
    This  prompt   has   formatting    issues...  
  
  

And inconsistent spacing.

-- anthropic-prompt.txt --
Explain quantum computing.

-- prompt-with-issues.txt --
this prompt needs capitalization.   
   And has trailing spaces.
